title: Motor Access Audit — Finding extensions
description: Audit-specific extensions to the base finding schema (shared/schemas/finding.base.schema.json). Adds fields; does not redefine the base contract. The Load displaced to field continues to use ONLY the shared 11-value enum defined in shared/finding-format.md — this extension introduces no new displacement values.

interaction_cost_class.description: The boundary distinction that runs through every MA section. 'exclusion' = the task is impossible by any available path for a population (no keyboard path, drag with no single-pointer alternative, non-extendable timeout, keyboard trap) — defaults to Critical. 'cost' = the task is completable by an available path, but at elevated motor effort, precision, or time (small target, drag with a working alternative, extendable-but-tight timeout) — scales Low to High by task centrality. 'n/a' for findings where the distinction does not apply. Optional but recommended on every finding; it is the field that keeps MA severities honest. Severity itself remains the base-schema Critical/High/Medium/Low.
